name: Written in the Stars
source:
After finally taking the steps towards publishing a childhood story, Seraphina began to feel the wear of her work. Once a kid who loved to create, she now has to answer to her editor and publisher in order to get her story heard. After slowly starting to hate the characters and story she once loved, Seraphina is transported to and trapped in the fairytale she wrote with no way of getting out. Can she create a "happily ever after" to escape the prison she wrote herself into?
